questions.questionText: What is the home world of the Adeptus Mechanicus?
What deity do the Adeptus Mechanicus worship, believed to be the Emperor in machine form?
questions.explanation: The Mechanicus venerate the Omnissiah, an aspect of the Machine God they believe the Emperor embodies.

questions.questionText: What title is held by the supreme leader of the Adeptus Mechanicus?
What are the Adeptus Mechanicus' rank-and-file soldier-servants called?
What term describes the Mechanicus' religious devotion to technology?
What is the general term for the cybernetic body enhancements common among Tech-Priests?
What is the name of the ancient pact granting the Adeptus Mechanicus autonomy within the Imperium?
What term describes Mechanicus expeditions sent to recover lost archeotech across the galaxy?
questions.explanation: Explorator fleets range far beyond Imperial space hunting for lost technology.
